evals.prompt: Set up scripts/win and scripts/linux so that anyone can download this repo, run a dev-setup command to create the virtual environment, and run dev-test.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds scripts/win/dev-setup.ps1, scripts/win/dev-test.ps1, scripts/linux/dev-setup.sh, and scripts/linux/dev-test.sh with proper permissions and dual-engine uv/venv support.
expectations: The scripts/linux/dev-setup.sh script exists and has strict mode enabled
The scripts/win/dev-setup.ps1 script exists and supports uv and venv fallback
The dev-test scripts support auto-bootstrapping and test filtering

evals.prompt: Create turnkey cross-platform developer onboarding scripts with uv acceleration and venv fallback for our project.
evals.expected_output: Invokes scaffold_dev_scripts.py to create the cross-platform scripts and runs validate_dev_scripts.py to verify parity and safety.
expectations: Scripts are isolated strictly to project-local .venv directory
Zero sudo or remote shell piping is used

evals.prompt: Validate that our scripts/win/dev-test.ps1 and scripts/linux/dev-test.sh have identical step parity and safe error handling.
evals.expected_output: Runs validate_dev_scripts.py and produces a clean parity report confirming matching steps, strict error handling, and safety invariants.
expectations: validate_dev_scripts.py runs and confirms cross-platform step parity
Both test scripts are verified for strict error handling and isolation
